title: Utility Engineering: Analyzing and Controlling Emergent Value Systems in AIs
benchmark_measurement: Implicit bias in the valuation of lives of people from different religious groups, measured via utility exchange rates.
findings: Using utility exchange rates, the paper found that GPT-4o implicitly values the lives of people from different religious groups unequally. Specifically, it was willing to trade approximately 10 Christian lives for the life of 1 atheist, demonstrating a significant bias in its emergent value system.
